title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Several Opinions on Providing Judicial Guarantee and Service for Accelerating the Transformation of the Economic Development Pattern
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the "Several Opinions on Providing Judicial Guarantee and Services for Accelerating the Transformation of the Economic Development Pattern"

Fa Fa [2010] No. 18

Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the central government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The "Several Opinions on Providing Judicial Guarantee and Services for Accelerating the Transformation of the Economic Development Pattern" of the Supreme People's Court is hereby issued to you. Please implement it earnestly in light of actual work circumstances.

June 29, 2010

Several Opinions on Providing Judicial Guarantee and Services for Accelerating the Transformation of the Economic Development Pattern

The Seventeenth National Congress of the Communist Party of China set forth the major strategic task of accelerating the transformation of the economic development pattern. Accelerating the transformation of the economic development pattern is the current focus of the Party and the state's economic work, an important goal and strategic measure for thoroughly implementing the Scientific Outlook on Development. To give full play to the adjudicative functions of the People's Courts, and to ensure the implementation of the strategic deployment and policy measures of the Party Central Committee regarding accelerating the transformation of the economic development pattern and maintaining steady and relatively rapid economic growth, these Opinions are hereby formulated.

1. Accelerating the transformation of the economic development pattern is a profound change in China's economic field, a major strategic deployment concerning the overall situation of reform, opening up, and socialist modernization, as well as the direction of China's economic development. It is an inevitable requirement to meet the goal of building a moderately prosperous society in all respects and to satisfy the people's new expectations for a better life. People's Courts at all levels must correctly understand the great significance of accelerating the transformation of China's economic development pattern, align their thinking and actions with the Party Central Committee's analysis of the situation and its decisions and deployments, further enhance their sense of responsibility and mission in providing judicial guarantee and services for accelerating the transformation of the economic development pattern, adopt practical and feasible measures, give full play to the adjudicative functions, and actively and effectively provide judicial guarantee and services for accelerating the transformation of the economic development pattern.

2. People's Courts shall earnestly study the new issues, new tasks, and new requirements that accelerating the transformation of the economic development pattern poses for the work of adjudication, so as to provide effective judicial guarantee and services for effectively accelerating the transformation of the economic development pattern. From a long-term perspective, accelerating the transformation of the economic development pattern will inevitably greatly promote China's steady and relatively rapid economic growth, better meet the people's growing material and cultural needs, help reduce social conflicts and disputes, and help alleviate the pressure on the adjudication work of People's Courts. However, in the near term, accelerating the transformation of the economic development pattern may give rise to some new conflicts and disputes. For example, the elimination of backward enterprises and production capacities, company liquidation, enterprise bankruptcy, mergers, and reorganizations will increase; and the adjustment of urban-rural structure will lead to an increase in land acquisition, house demolition, etc. A considerable portion of the conflicts and disputes arising from these activities will enter the litigation process, thus posing new challenges to the adjudication work of People's Courts. Therefore, People's Courts at all levels must adhere to judicial activism, anticipate problems early, act quickly, respond actively, and implement policies appropriately. They shall accurately grasp the orientation of judicial policies, protect, guide, and support in accordance with the law economic activities and behaviors that are conducive to accelerating the transformation of the economic development pattern, ensuring early results in accelerating the transformation. Actively guide backward enterprises and enterprises with high energy consumption and high pollution to withdraw from the market in accordance with the law, and shall not support economic activities and behaviors that are not conducive to accelerating the transformation of the economic development pattern in accordance with the law.

3. Properly adjudicate cases related to economic structural adjustment, and guarantee and serve the optimization and adjustment of the economic structure. Adjudicate various types of investment dispute cases in accordance with the law, promote the diversification of social investment entities, strengthen equal protection of the legitimate rights and interests of small and medium-sized investors, encourage and guide capital to flow towards new energy, new materials, energy conservation and environmental protection, biomedicine, information networks, and high-end manufacturing industries. Protect the legitimate rights and interests of private enterprises and state-owned enterprises equally in accordance with the law, properly adjudicate relevant cases, carefully adopt property preservation and compulsory enforcement measures, and promote the common development of private and state-owned enterprises. Legally support new types of legitimate guarantee methods, correctly determine the validity of such contracts, and help solve the financing difficulties of small and medium-sized enterprises. Properly adjudicate cases involving small and medium-sized enterprises in accordance with the law, and promote the healthy development of small and medium-sized enterprises. Accurately grasp the boundary between civil disputes and economic crimes, and properly handle relevant criminal cases in accordance with the law.

4. Properly adjudicate disputes over consumer rights and interests, and guarantee and serve the formation of an economic growth pattern driven by the coordinated pulling of consumption, investment, and exports. Accurately grasp the judicial principles for adjudicating cases concerning consumer rights disputes. While legally protecting the legitimate interests of business operators, also pay attention to protecting the legitimate rights and interests of consumers, and promote the establishment of a fair, orderly, and trustworthy consumption environment. Correctly determine the validity of consumer contracts, declare invalid "arbitrary clauses" that damage consumers' legitimate rights and interests in accordance with the law, and protect consumers' legitimate rights and interests. Properly adjudicate disputes arising from real estate development and the sale and lease of houses, and regulate the order of real estate transactions. Properly adjudicate cases of consumer credit disputes such as personal housing, automobiles, education, etc., and guide the establishment of a healthy, coordinated, and orderly consumer credit order. Punish in accordance with the law criminal acts that seriously disrupt the order of the market economy, such as the production and sale of toxic and harmful food, counterfeit and substandard drugs, and counterfeit agricultural materials.

5. Properly adjudicate various types of cases arising from the adjustment of urban-rural structure, and guarantee and serve the construction of urbanization. Correctly adjudicate civil and administrative cases such as land acquisition and house demolition, strengthen the protection of the legitimate interests of land-lost farmers and demolished persons, legally support urbanization construction that conforms to planning. Legally handle conflicts and disputes arising from farmers' investment of land compensation funds as shares, and legally protect farmers' investment rights and interests. Severely crack down on illegal and criminal acts such as embezzlement and misappropriation of land acquisition compensation funds and house demolition compensation funds, and regulate and maintain the order of land acquisition and house demolition.

6. Properly adjudicate various types of disputes in the service sector, and guarantee and serve the development of the modern service industry. Adjudicate contract dispute cases in education, tourism, telecommunications, logistics, information, research and development, industrial design, commerce, energy conservation and environmental protection services, etc., in accordance with the law. While supporting and guaranteeing the development of modern service industries oriented towards production and serving the people's livelihood, also promptly correct improper conduct by service providers, regulate and guide service providers to continuously improve management and service levels. Strengthen information exchange with competent departments and industry associations of the service industry, promptly report problems found in the adjudication of cases relating to the development of the service industry, and propose judicial recommendations.

7. Properly adjudicate financial dispute cases, and guarantee and serve the development of the modern financial industry. Adjudicate loan dispute cases in accordance with the law, effectively protect the legitimate claims of banks and other financial institutions, prevent acts of evading bank debts, and maintain financial order and financial security. Adjudicate deposit dispute cases in accordance with the law, effectively safeguard the security and interests of depositors' savings. Properly handle the adjudication of financial instrument dispute cases, and maintain financial credit order and transaction security in accordance with the law. Adjudicate insurance dispute cases in accordance with the law, support the timely receipt of insurance compensation by the insured and insurance beneficiaries in accordance with the law, and maintain the healthy development of the insurance industry. Adjudicate securities dispute cases in accordance with the law, fully protect shareholders' rights, and promote the orderly development of the securities market. Properly adjudicate non-financial loan dispute cases, correctly determine the validity of non-financial loan contracts, crack down on various illegal and criminal activities such as illegal fundraising disguised as legitimate forms in accordance with the law, and maintain financial security and social stability. Protect legitimate private lending and corporate financing activities in accordance with the law, protect the legitimate rights and interests of creditors, and broaden corporate financing channels. In economically developed areas, financial tribunals may be established to specialize in adjudicating relevant financial cases.

8. Properly handle relevant bankruptcy and compulsory liquidation cases, guarantee the achievement of the economic development goal of eliminating backward and excess production capacity, and promote industrial transformation and upgrading. Accept enterprise bankruptcy and compulsory liquidation cases in accordance with the law, actively guide market entities to exit the market in an orderly manner in accordance with the law. Accept applications for enterprise reorganization and conciliation that meet the conditions in accordance with the law, use the enterprise reorganization and conciliation system to help and support enterprises that are experiencing temporary difficulties in capital turnover but meet the requirements of national economic and industrial structure adjustment and have development prospects to recover their vitality and return to the market.

9. Properly handle labor dispute and social insurance cases, and effectively ensure people's livelihood. Adjudicate various disputes arising from the conclusion, performance, modification, rescission, or termination of labor contracts between workers and employers in accordance with the law, effectively protect workers' rights to labor remuneration. Adjudicate administrative cases concerning labor security, work-related injury determination, social insurance, etc., in accordance with the law, support and supervise labor security administrative departments in exercising their administrative functions in accordance with the law, and effectively protect workers' legitimate rights and interests. Actively guide enterprises to earnestly assume social responsibilities, strengthen the protection of workers' rights and interests, guide workers to establish a concept of honest work and common development, and promote mutual benefit and win-win development between enterprises and workers.

10. Properly adjudicate various types of disputes arising in agricultural development, encourage and support the development of emerging rural industries, and guarantee and serve the transformation of the rural economic development pattern. Promptly adjudicate various disputes arising from the secondary and tertiary industries in rural areas, farmers working outside their hometowns, and returning to their hometowns to start businesses, effectively protect farmers' legitimate rights and interests. Adjudicate contract disputes concerning the transfer, subcontracting, leasing, etc., of land contractual management rights in accordance with the law, and protect the order of the transfer of land contractual management rights. Support and promote the construction of the rural financial service system, and broaden rural financing channels.

11. Properly adjudicate various types of intellectual property cases, and guarantee and serve the promotion of independent innovation. Strengthen judicial protection of intellectual property in key areas, and promote the development of strategic industries. Strengthen the protection of well-known trademarks, geographical indications of agricultural products, and trademark rights in strategic emerging industries and modern service industries, and promote the formation of independent brands and the development of brand economy. Enhance the protection of independent intellectual property rights for key core technologies, promote the development of high-tech industries such as new energy, new medicine, new materials, and environmental protection, and safeguard the core competitiveness of enterprises. Properly adjudicate antitrust and unfair competition cases, stop monopolistic behavior in technological development and technology transfer, prevent abuse of intellectual property rights to restrict innovation, and maintain fair market competition order. Strengthen copyright protection in fields such as news publishing, radio, film and television, literature and art, cultural entertainment, advertising design, arts and crafts, computer software, and information networks, punish criminal acts such as counterfeiting trademarks, patents, and copyright infringement in accordance with the law, promote cultural innovation, and prosper the cultural market.

12. Properly adjudicate various types of foreign-related commercial, maritime, and admiralty cases, and guarantee and serve the transformation of the foreign economic development pattern. Adjudicate foreign investment dispute cases in accordance with the law, maintain a stable and fair foreign investment environment, actively guide the direction of foreign investment, continuously improve the quality of foreign capital utilization, and promote foreign capital to play a positive role in promoting technological innovation, industrial upgrading, and coordinated regional development. Promptly adjudicate cases concerning the recognition and enforcement of foreign arbitral awards and judgments, maintain the finality of arbitration, accurately understand the provisions of international conventions, bilateral or multilateral treaties, carefully apply the public policy clause, and promote foreign judicial cooperation and assistance. Accurately apply foreign law, international treaties, and international practices in accordance with the law, properly adjudicate foreign trade and transport dispute cases, equally protect the litigation rights and substantive rights and interests of Chinese and foreign parties, promote the steady growth of import and export trade, and safeguard China's economic security. Attach great importance to the adjudication of cases involving Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macao, and effectively improve the quality and efficiency of adjudication.

13. Properly adjudicate various types of environmental protection dispute cases, and guarantee and serve the promotion of energy conservation, emission reduction, and environmental protection. Accept various types of compensation disputes arising from environmental pollution in accordance with the law, correctly apply the burden of proof distribution rules in environmental tort cases, accurately determine the causal relationship between environmental pollution and damage consequences, and ensure that victims of environmental torts receive timely and comprehensive compensation. Promptly adjudicate environmental protection administrative litigation cases, strengthen the review and enforcement of non-litigation administrative cases related to environmental protection, and support and supervise environmental protection administrative law enforcement agencies in performing their environmental protection functions in accordance with the law. Accept compensation disputes for environmental pollution damages brought by environmental protection administrative departments on behalf of the state in accordance with the law, and severely crack down on all acts that damage the environment. Properly handle conflicts and disputes arising from the development and utilization of natural resources such as land and minerals, protect the legitimate rights and interests of right holders in accordance with the law, support the rational development and utilization of abandoned mining lands, and promote the transformation and upgrading of resource-based enterprises. Strictly implement environmental and resource protection laws and regulations, protect and promote the development of circular economy and energy-saving and environmental protection industries in accordance with the law, resolutely punish illegal and criminal acts that pollute the environment, destroy forest resources, grassland resources, biological resources, etc., and promote sustainable socio-economic development. In courts where there is a high volume of environmental protection dispute cases, environmental protection tribunals may be established to implement specialized adjudication of environmental protection cases and improve the level of environmental protection justice.

14. Fully implement the criminal policy of combining leniency with strictness, crack down on crimes that seriously endanger public security and the interests of the people in accordance with the law, and maintain social stability. Punish economic crimes in accordance with the law, and maintain the socialist economic order. Properly handle criminal cases arising from group incidents. Actively participate in the assistance, education, and management of special groups and in comprehensive social security management, establish long-term working mechanisms, implement various measures of comprehensive social security management, support and cooperate with relevant departments in carrying out the construction of a social security prevention and control system and grassroots peace-building activities, prevent and reduce crime, and maintain social order.

15. Attach great importance to the use of mediation methods to effectively resolve various conflicts and disputes triggered during the transformation of the economic development pattern. Conscientiously implement the work principle of "mediation first, combining mediation with adjudication," actively promote the construction of a "trinity" grand mediation pattern integrating judicial mediation, people's mediation, and administrative mediation, increase mediation efforts, fully leverage the active role of all sectors of society in resolving conflicts and disputes, form the maximum joint force of the whole society in resolving conflicts and disputes, do everything possible to resolve conflicts at the grassroots level and in the bud, and avoid triggering group incidents due to improper handling.

16. Attach great importance to and properly handle various types of petition cases related to litigation arising from accelerating the transformation of the economic development pattern, promptly discover and remedy weak links in case handling, and continuously improve the level of case handling. Strengthen the construction of case-filing and petition windows, improve the judicial convenience service system such as litigation services, improve the mechanism for public opinion communication and expression, promote the dispute resolution mechanism that connects litigation with non-litigation, fully complete the task of clearing up backlogged petition cases related to litigation, and strive to create a fair and efficient judicial environment and a stable and harmonious social environment for accelerating the transformation of the economic development pattern.

17. People's Courts at all levels shall promptly report relevant situations to local Party committees and People's Congresses, and communicate well with governments. They shall exchange information with relevant departments in a timely manner, achieve information resource sharing, and establish corresponding coordination mechanisms to ensure the effective implementation of various response measures for providing judicial guarantee and services for accelerating the transformation of the economic development pattern. In recent years, deputies to the National People's Congress and members of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference have put forward many good suggestions and proposals on how People's Courts perform their adjudicative functions under changing economic circumstances. People's Courts at all levels must attach great importance to them, promptly report the handling status, and increase the satisfaction rate of handling work. They shall strengthen contacts with deputies to the People's Congress and members of the Political Consultative Conference, various democratic parties, the Federation of Industry and Commerce, non-party personages, experts, scholars, lawyers, the people, etc., and sincerely listen to their opinions and suggestions on the work of People's Courts. Give full play to the role of specially invited advisors and special supervisors, providing decision-making consultation and supervisory opinions for the work of People's Courts, and improve the level of scientific and democratic decision-making. Conscientiously implement the provisions on accepting supervision by news media and public opinion, humbly listen to the opinions of the media and netizens, and continuously improve work.

18. Effectively strengthen relevant judicial research work, firmly grasp the foresight and initiative in providing judicial guarantee and services for accelerating the transformation of the economic development pattern. Leading cadres and relevant judicial officers of People's Courts at all levels shall go deep into the grassroots, go deep into reality, go deep into rural areas, go deep into enterprises, strengthen contact and communication with enterprises, and promptly understand the new demands and new expectations of the people for judicial work. Make full use of judicial statistical data to promptly discover new situations and new problems arising from accelerating the transformation of the economic development pattern. Strengthen the analysis and study of legal issues that may be involved in the transformation of the economic development pattern, and under the leadership of Party committees at all levels and with the cooperation of relevant departments, promptly propose various judicial response measures and judicial recommendations for providing judicial guarantee and services for accelerating the transformation of the economic development pattern. Promptly summarize and promote good experiences and good practices from various places, and continuously improve the effectiveness of the work of providing judicial guarantee and services for accelerating the transformation of the economic development pattern.

In the new era, the adjudication work of People's Courts is arduous and the responsibility is heavy. Under the strong leadership of the Party, People's Courts at all levels shall guide adjudication work with the Scientific Outlook on Development, adhere to the guiding ideology of "Three Supremes," adhere to the work theme of "Serving the Overall Situation and Administering Justice for the People," strengthen the concept of judicial activism, practice the purpose of justice for the people, deeply promote the three key tasks of resolving social conflicts, innovating social management, and upholding integrity and integrity in law enforcement, and provide more powerful judicial guarantee and services for accelerating the transformation of the economic development pattern and achieving steady and relatively rapid economic growth in China.
